channel.title: Eswatini - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Eswatini, every source cited.

item.title: Bullet lodged in girl's foot after shooting incident
item.description: An eight-year-old girl in Ekupheleni had a pistol bullet removed from her foot after weeks of medical attention failed to heal the injury.

item.title: Mbabane Highlanders AM beat Mbabane Swallows 2-0
item.description: Zwelihle Phewa scored a penalty in the 43rd minute and Bhekani Mthembu added a stoppage-time goal.

item.title: Eswatini launches youth jobs project
item.description: The Eswatini Youth Employment Opportunities Project will offer training and support for entrepreneurship in agriculture and construction.

item.title: Eswatini taekwondo team wins nine medals in Mozambique
item.description: The nine-member Next Generation Academy team secured four gold, four silver, and three bronze medals at the AUSC Region V Test Event.

item.title: Eswatini fuel prices climb 51.2%
item.description: The Ministry of Economic Planning and Development warns of rising production costs and weakened export competitiveness.
